title: Routewise Embedding + Ranker Health: Dashboards, Traces, Cost Attribution
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Objective: Ship route-scoped observability for the embeddings + reranker endpoint so SRE, platform, and product teams can: (1) see per-route quality and latency trends, (2) attribute cost to embedding compute vs vector search vs reranker, and (3) detect regressions via traces and alerts. Scope includes dashboards, span-level tracing hooks, cost breakdown instrumentation, and alert rules. Non-goals: automated remediation, per-customer billing UI (follow-up).
acceptance_criteria: Per-route dashboard in Console that shows p50/p95/p99 latency for embedding call, vector search, and reranker step for the last 7d and 30d
Trace correlation implemented: every embedding/rerank span attaches route_id and request_id; traces link to an example request in the Console
Cost attribution metric emitted per request with component buckets: embed_compute, search_cpu/gpu, rerank_cpu, downstream_tokens; rollout includes backfilled daily cost for last 30 days
Alerting rules: per-route p95 latency spike alert + cost rate-of-change alert with configurable thresholds in Console
Instrumentation rollout plan executed: shadow sampling at 1% -> 10% -> 100% with smoke tests and fallback safety checks
Docs and runbook published with examples for diagnosing: high embed latency, high rerank CPU, and vector search timeouts
notes: Background: Customers running high-QPS semantic search have observed occasional tail latency and unexpected cost spikes when reranking large candidate sets. We currently only expose aggregate metrics; on-call must jump between logs and billing to triage.

Design trade-offs: emitting fine-grained span tags increases telemetry volume and cost. Plan is to emit full spans for sampled requests and lightweight aggregated counters for all requests. Sampling will be probabilistic by route with config exposed in Console.

Telemetry schema decisions: add event types 'embed_request', 'embed_response', 'rerank_cycle' with fields route_id, model_id, candidate_count, input_bytes, output_tokens, cpu_ms, gpu_ms. Keep schema flat to simplify ingestion and downstream joins.

Cost model: use billing export to compute unit price for GPU/CPU and allocate per-request using gpu_ms/cpu_ms. For vector search hosted providers, attribute based on API call count + average per-call cost from usage logs.
Privacy: no user PII in spans; confirm with Security that route_id is safe. Security review requested if route names expose customer ids (decision: enforce anonymized route_id format).
implementation_plan: Week 1: Instrumentation - add span tags and lightweight counters to embedding and rerank code paths; add route sampling config; unit tests for telemetry fields
Week 2: Ingestion - update telemetry pipeline to parse new events, compute per-request cost buckets, and expose aggregate series (by route) in metrics DB
Week 3: Dashboards - Console tiles for latency waterfall (embed -> search -> rerank -> tokens), cost Sankey, and error heatmap; add drilldowns to single-trace view
Week 4: Alerting & Rollout - create default alert thresholds, run 1% -> 10% shadow rollout, validate accuracy vs billing, promote to 100% and enable notifications for SRE and PM channel
Post-release: Backfill 30d using billing export, adjust thresholds, and capture lessons in postmortem if any regressions observed
